label: 2.00ct E VVS2 — first comparison, quiet centre
commentary: First of two separate 2.00ct E VVS2 Asschers in the paired video (#1), measuring 6.95 × 6.92 mm with reported depth 66.6%, table 58% and crown 16% / 37.6°. Ibrakeforpossums found its movement comparatively quiet, particularly through the centre, and preferred the second stone (#2); the buyer also preferred the second (#3). This is an observation relative to the pair, not a calibrated failure or proof that the dimensions caused the movement.

source_links.note: Shared original comparison video; R14 is the FIRST stone.
